protocol.comparison: Current cell mean and speed-weighted moment versus speeds of subsequently crossing identified vehicles
protocol.crossing_speed: Linear interpolation of two5s endpoint speeds along each vehicle path; not exact crossing-speed measurement
protocol.outer_censoring: Report upstream vehicles absent from next spatial excerpt; do not count as exits
protocol.causal_proxy_only: Moment/edge inputs are current snapshot; reference crossing speed uses next sample

limitations: No full flux reconstruction: unmatched vehicles are censored, not treated as exits.
Endpoint speed interpolation assumes linear change over5s; before/after speeds are sensitivity values, not rigorous bounds.
Current microscopic moments are not available from the future scalar METANET state without an autonomous closure.
Comparing model-form convection terms is not proof of a full physical or control benefit.
